title: Midnight Sunwatch
text:
🌙 Midnight Sunwatch — November 21, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B3.7)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B4.9 (Peaked November 21, 2026 at 01:24 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 335 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.67)

Looks pretty quiet right now. 🌎

A few modest active regions and small sunspot groups are visible, with no clearly significant outward coronal structure.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 335 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
